note: Generated from the annexes of specs/100-specstride by contracts/tools/generate.py. The annex stands where the two differ.

redactor.Input: A secret value that the runtime resolved
redactor.Output: Nothing. The value is matched exactly from then on

redactor.Input: A text and a size cap
redactor.Output: The redacted, cut text; how many replacements were made; the version of the pattern set

hasher.Input: The bytes of a file, or a text taken as UTF-8

hasher.Output: The record as text with sorted keys, compact separators, non-ASCII characters kept, and no final line end. It is the input of the canonical record hash, and the form in which the Specstride baseline hashes the records of its verification plan
A SHA-256 hash that does not change when a checkbox is ticked or cleared
The content hash of the canonical record text with one line end added

hasher.Operation: Phase shape, obligation id, signature of unmet criteria
hasher.Input: For the phase shape: the number, title and criteria of a phase; for the obligation id and the signature of unmet criteria: the text that each owner forms
hasher.Output: As at the baseline; equal to the baseline's on the same input. The phase shape is built by the hasher (16 hexadecimal characters; rules: feature 104, F104-FR-021). The obligation id (rules: feature 107, F107-FR-004) and the signature of unmet criteria (rules: feature 101, F101-FR-019) are formed by their owners over the content hash of a text; the hasher holds no rule of theirs

hasher.Input: The recorded sources (logical name, repository-relative path, recorded hashes) and, for each, its hashes now or the mark that it cannot be read
hasher.Output: For each source `unchanged`, `ticks-only`, `changed` or `unreadable`, and the verdict `fresh` or `stale`; a pure function that reads no file (rules: feature 104, F104-FR-024)
